definitions.explanation: A feeling of sadness or disappointment about something one did or failed to do. Often used about past actions that cannot be undone.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦していれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{悔|く}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: I regret not having tried harder back then.

examples.japanese: {悔|く}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}りたい→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I want to live a life without regrets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{悔|く}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}えて→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧⟦{生|い}きた→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧。

examples.english: If I had spoken up back then, I probably wouldn't have this regret.

examples.english: Losing the match is frustrating, but I gave it everything I had, so I have no regrets.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {悔|く}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ (to be left with regret)
- {悔|く}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧〜 (a 〜 without regret)
- {悔|く}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ (to leave regrets behind)
- {悔|く}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}える→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧ (to carry a regret)
- ⟦{悔|く}い{改|あらた}める→悔い改める：19907_kuiaratameru⟧ (to repent, to reform oneself)

USAGE:
{悔|く}い is more literary than ⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧ and appears mostly in the set phrases above; in everyday conversation ⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is the ordinary choice. {悔|く}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make a choice one will not regret) is common when facing a major decision.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧ (regret): the everyday word, a noun and ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb
- ⟦{悔|く}いる→悔いる：25247_kuiru⟧ (to regret): the verb this noun comes from
- ⟦{悔|くや}む→悔やむ：14725_kuyamu⟧ (to regret, to lament): also used of mourning the dead
